source.title: Warhammer 40,000: The App 2.7.1, data build 972, released 2026-10-02

data.summary: The next [Order](vsdata:ability/astra-militarum.voice-of-command) this model issues can go to an eligible unit of yours up to 12" from it. If it is the first Order any unit of yours issues in [your Command phase](vsdata:core-rule/command-phase), it affects that unit and also each other eligible unit of yours up to 6" from that unit.

ability.appliesTo: next Order issued by this model

spread.condition: army's first Order this Command phase
spread.of: the unit that received the Order
